source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor will change status when module is removed or inserted
Check SEL will have corresponding logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All STATUS_FAN1~16 should get pass result.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL only notes a missing command and incorrectly implies raw bytes are required; it misses the physical fan-service action, 1~N versus 1~16 scope conflict and status-versus-temperature criteria conflict.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED correctly identifies both direct semantic contradictions and the physical cooling risk.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 797/2291 repeats PARTIAL while reproducing the conflicting Criteria; it does not resolve the authoritative fan population or signal type.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-962 draft was inspected only as history; this review independently preserves the high-level source read path, separates status from thermal evidence and defines the exact engineer decision without lowering coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 prevents replacing the physical status transition with read-only inspection, ED-36 does not excuse irreconcilable criteria, and ED-38 reserves source correction and verdict ownership for engineers.

original_test_intent: The Procedure appears to validate per-fan presence/status and SEL transitions across physical removal and reinsertion, but the authoritative population and acceptance signal cannot be fixed by AI because Items say 1~N while Criteria require 1~16 and judge temperature thresholds instead of status events.
original_method: Read fan status with `ipmitool sdr elist`, have an engineer remove and reinsert the approved fan module, and correlate status and SEL. The preserved Criteria instead describe a thermal-threshold test and therefore cannot presently produce a valid status verdict.
manual_activity: Only after correction, an engineer identifies and physically services one approved hot-swappable fan at a time, while automation captures mapped status, SEL, RPM, thermal and host evidence. Non-hot-swappable hardware requires the vendor service state rather than live removal.
required_inputs: Engineer-approved canonical population: Project-fitted 1~N, exactly 1~16, or a defined applicability rule
Corrected Review-layer acceptance matrix for presence/status assert/deassert, or an explicit decision to split status and thermal-threshold purposes
Fan slot/module/FRU, STATUS_FAN sensor, RPM sensor, SDR type, normal/absent/fault state and SEL event mapping
Vendor hot-swap/service capability, fan redundancy/zone policy, minimum cooling, system load, temperature limits and removal/reinsertion timing
Supported high-level IPMI/Redfish/vendor read path, BMC/SDR/chassis versions, operator approval and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not assume N equals 16, treat temperature thresholds as fan presence, or select a physical module until engineers align the population and acceptance semantics.
Do not invent raw IPMI bytes; the Master already names a high-level SDR read, which must be mapped to supported sensor records after correction.
Do not remove a fan live unless the exact module is vendor-approved for hot-swap and the remaining fan/zone redundancy plus thermal margin are confirmed.

After correction, service only one mapped fan at a time under attended monitoring; abort on rapid inlet/component temperature rise, unexpected peer-fan behavior, redundancy loss, BMC/host instability or wrong sensor transition.
Preserve first status/SEL/thermal evidence, never clear logs or repeat a removal automatically, and reinsert/secure the module through the approved SOP.
Verify presence, RPM/control, peer fans, temperatures, SEL deassertion and host/BMC health recover before any next fan.
agent_execution_scope: Before correction, perform no DUT or physical action and only preserve the source conflict and required decision.

After correction and approval, bind every sample to fan slot/module/FRU/sensor identity, collect baseline, observe engineer-performed removal/reinsertion and capture status, RPM, peer-fan, temperature, SEL and host timelines.
Produce one independent assert/deassert and recovery result per applicable fan; keep any temperature-threshold test as a separately authorized checkpoint rather than status evidence.
Do not remove hardware, infer N, issue raw commands, change fan policy/thresholds, clear evidence, retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Decide the authoritative fan count/applicability and whether the case is presence/status, temperature threshold, or two separately scoped checkpoints; record the correction in the Review layer while preserving Master.
Approve the fan map, event semantics, hot-swap/service SOP, redundancy/load/thermal envelope, abort and recovery.
Perform or supervise each physical action and issue per-fan plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its placeholder is not executable and its raw-byte premise is unsupported by the high-level Master command. More importantly, no command can repair the conflicting population and signal acceptance semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No physical execution until engineer correction. Afterwards use the mapped high-level read-only fan-status/SEL interface while an engineer performs the approved service action and independent thermal monitoring remains active.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact `STATUS_FAN 1~N` Items, physical removal/insertion, `ipmitool sdr elist`, temperature Criteria, `STATUS_FAN1~16` clause, script and 5/10-minute estimates remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Align the canonical population and status-specific acceptance matrix, then service one mapped hot-swappable fan at a time, correlate presence/status and SEL assert/deassert, monitor cooling compensation, reinsert and prove recovery; run thermal-threshold coverage separately if retained.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Engineer-corrected chassis fan population, slot/zone/redundancy design and BMC/SDR event model.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/fan FRU, BMC/SDR/fan-controller firmware and read-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan population/service/hot-swap, redundancy/thermal limit, SDR status and SEL event specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Does not overwrite Master; it separates status events from copied thermal criteria and replaces the open N/16 ambiguity with an engineer-owned matrix.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only presence, a subset of fans or temperature behavior cannot satisfy the unresolved full status population; post-correction coverage is per applicable fan.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Engineer population and signal decision, fan/event map, service SOP and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing the wrong or non-hot-swappable fan can compromise a cooling zone faster than BMC status evidence can be collected.

project_override_considerations: A Project-specific fitted count may define applicability only after engineer approval and must be recorded explicitly; it cannot silently rewrite N to 16 or convert temperature evidence into presence/status coverage.
expected_evidence: Preserved Master conflict plus dated engineer decision for N versus 16 and status versus temperature scope
Canonical fan slot/module/FRU/status/RPM/SDR/SEL/applicability matrix and hot-swap/service capability
Approved one-fan-at-a-time SOP, redundancy/load/thermal margin, abort and reinsertion/recovery plan
Per-fan baseline/removal/reinsertion status, RPM, peer compensation, temperatures, SEL and host/BMC timeline tied to physical-action timestamps
Separate status assert/deassert result and any separately executed thermal-threshold evidence
Secured reinsertion, recovered status/RPM/cooling/temperatures/SEL/host/BMC health and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items specify STATUS_FAN 1~N, Criterion 5 specifies STATUS_FAN1~16, and Criteria 1-4 evaluate temperature change and threshold behavior while Procedure performs fan presence removal/insertion. Both the test population and acceptance signal conflict directly.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is not a missing package or ordinary Project value: AI cannot decide whether N equals 16 or whether physical status, temperature thresholds or both determine completion. Performing fan removal before correction cannot yield an authoritative verdict and creates cooling risk.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes its PARTIAL/package-only view to a true semantic BLOCKED finding; the missing implementation command is secondary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on BLOCKED and retains its signal/population contradictions while adding an explicit post-decision hybrid automation boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Keeps the block but restores the source high-level tool, distinguishes non-hot-swap service state and defines per-fan recovery and separate thermal coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents physical fan service from producing a false verdict against the wrong population or an unrelated temperature criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Presence/status changes are discrete module events; temperature thresholds are continuous thermal events and may never occur during a brief removal. Likewise, an open-ended fitted population cannot be equated to sixteen without authority. Those conflicts define the core acceptance claim, so the review can finish but DUT execution must remain blocked pending engineer correction.
